description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.19.9 is a feature release for macOS, Windows and Linux on top of 0.19.8, with fuller Antigravity CLI integration, Codex credit balances, linked-mission archiving and remote mission linking.
New
- Antigravity CLI usage. The sidebar footer, Usage popover, Settings → Usage and near-limit notifications now include Antigravity CLI (1.5.8 or newer). The footer badge shows the weekly Gemini Models percentage, while Usage and Settings list the Gemini Models and Claude and GPT models pools separately. Runner checks sign-in before reading /usage so signed-out accounts never open browser login automatically, and collapses extra sidebar badges into +N when the footer is narrow. (#1286, #1309)
- Codex credits remaining. The Usage popover and Settings → Usage now show your remaining Codex credit balance below its quota windows, rounded to the nearest whole credit (or Unlimited / Unavailable). Credits stay visible when the 5-hour limit is hidden and do not expire when quota windows reset. (#1279)
- Archive linked missions with their chat. Archiving a chat that has unarchived linked missions now asks for confirmation and stops and archives those missions with it, while keeping their link so each can still be restored from Settings → Archived. From the CLI, pass --with-missions to runner session archive to archive linked missions too. (#1290)
- Link and unlink missions from a remote window. A window connected to another computer can now link or unlink missions to agent chats in the same project using Link to chat, Unlink from <chat>, or by dragging missions into or out of a chat's group, when the host is on 0.19.9 or newer. (#1297)
- Native terminal status for Antigravity CLI. Antigravity CLI chats and missions now report Working, Idle, completed responses, failures, and approval, question and authentication waits through OSC 7501 terminal status (1.5.8 or newer) instead of status hooks, so sessions run directly in their working folder without an injected hooks directory. Resuming an older session keeps its legacy hooks folder in place so shell commands keep working. (#1295, #1316)
- Automatic chat titles for Antigravity CLI. Antigravity CLI chats now rename their tab and pane automatically from the conversation title and /rename, while keeping any name you set in Runner. (#1292)
- Bypass permissions and symlink-safe folder trust for Antigravity CLI. Settings → Agents → Antigravity CLI adds a Bypass permissions switch for chats (off by default, passing --dangerously-skip-permissions). Starting a chat or mission through a symlinked path such as /tmp now trusts both the symlink and its resolved folder so Antigravity CLI no longer pauses on a folder-trust prompt. (#1288)
Bug fixes
- Antigravity CLI models and Effort selector. Model discovery for Antigravity CLI 1.5.8 now groups effort-suffixed entries into a single base model paired with the Effort selector (low, medium, high, xhigh, and max where supported) across Start Chat, Roles and Crew slots, and disables Effort when no model is selected or the model does not take an effort flag. (#1294)
- Windows drive paths and file:// links in the terminal. ⌘-clicking or Ctrl-clicking a terminal link now opens local file:// URLs (plain text or terminal hyperlinks targeting this computer or localhost), Windows drive-letter paths (C:\... and C:/...), UNC paths (\\server\share\...), and #Lline or (line,column) suffixes in the Files side panel or your configured editor. (#1300)
- Remote mission member tabs update while away. When a remote mission adds or removes members while you are viewing another tab or mission—or while the mission is stopped and reopened—its member tabs now update to match while keeping any tabs you closed yourself closed. (#1106)
- No empty-mission flash in remote feeds. Opening a remote mission with no roles no longer flashes "No events yet." before its feed finishes loading or jumps the feed layout on overview updates, and keeps the host-only Add role card out of the remote feed. (#1306)
- Focus stays in the split after closing a pane. Closing the focused pane in a split tab with × or ⌘W / Ctrl+Shift+W now reliably moves keyboard focus to the surviving pane so you can keep typing without clicking it. (#1283)
- Copied feedback on the launch command preview. Clicking Copy on the Chat or Mission command preview in Settings → Agents now shows a checkmark and "Copied" confirmation, and disables the button when no preview is available. (#1284)
- Cleaner agent update and Usage rows. Running and completed agent updates in Settings → Agents no longer show a duplicate Show output button beside the background-task pill, and single-line agent rows in Settings → Usage align cleanly with their switches. (#1309, #1310)
